$comment: Evidence map for Phase 25. This records current artefacts; it does not claim runtime, persistence, or production completion.

areas.requirement: School, university, company, government agency, community institution and non-profit inputs use the same governed onboarding flow.

evidence.contains: accepts every organization class through ONE pipeline

areas.requirement: The lifecycle requires ordered transitions and artifacts for tenant, administrator, policy, workspace and runtime activation.

areas.area: Institution identity does not become its administrator
areas.requirement: The organization identity and initial administrator remain distinct identities.

evidence.contains: never makes the organization identity the initial administrator

areas.area: Workforce kinds and positions remain governed structure
areas.requirement: Workforce catalogs and position records describe institutional structure without implying authorization.
Invitations have governed creation and lifecycle behavior.

areas.area: Activated organizations receive derived runtime context
areas.requirement: Workspace and runtime context are exposed only after onboarding activation.

evidence.contains: exposes the derived surface context only after activation

areas.area: Onboarding records are persisted and enforced at a live boundary
areas.requirement: A tenant-isolated persistence schema and live authorized boundary store and enforce onboarding records.
